chapters.title: Control and Coordination
chapters.sourceReview: 40 original English–Tamil question-bank entries in four sets on neurons/reflexes, brain, plant tropisms and endocrine hormones. NCERT 2025–26 original-reprint chapter text was inspected and PDF screenshots of printed pages 101, 108 and 110 were reviewed; exact 2026–27 source and independent Tamil proofreading still pending.

chapters.title: How do Organisms Reproduce?
chapters.sourceReview: NCERT Chapter 7 topics were checked against text extracted from a 2025–26 reprint (English printed pp. 113–127), supporting 20 newly written English–Tamil questions. The reference PDF could not be visually rendered in this review; exact 2026–27 edition, figure/page comparisons and Tamil editorial quality remain pending independent verification.

chapters.title: Heredity
chapters.sourceReview: NCERT Chapter 8 'Heredity' text of the 2025–26 reprint was consulted (English printed pp. 128–133), supporting 20 original English–Tamil application questions. The reference PDF could not be visually rendered; exact 2026–27 edition, diagrams, page alignments and Tamil editorial quality remain pending verification.

chapters.title: Light – Reflection and Refraction
chapters.sourceReview: Twenty original English–Tamil questions now published in two sets on mirror ray diagrams, refraction, lens calculations and optical image formation. Chapter/section sequence corroborated against the current NCERT-aligned text; official chapter PDF retrieval timed out. Page references and Tamil answers are provisional pending independent official 2026–27 edition/source-page verification.

chapters.title: The Human Eye and the Colourful World
chapters.sourceReview: Two original English–Tamil practice sets (20 questions) now cover eye anatomy, accommodation, vision defects, prism dispersion, rainbow formation, atmospheric refraction, twinkling and scattering. Chapter themes and provisional printed-page locations were checked against NCERT-aligned 2026 study references. Official 2026–27 PDF page-by-page verification and independent Tamil proofreading remain pending; no chapter certification is claimed.

chapters.title: Electricity
chapters.sourceReview: Twenty original bilingual MCQs in two sets cover current, potential difference, Ohm's law, resistance and resistivity, series/parallel circuits, Joule heating, electrical power and energy. Numerical values were independently recomputed during authoring. The printable-page map follows the 2025–26 chapter reference; official 2026–27 item-to-page comparison and independent Tamil editorial review remain pending.

chapters.title: Magnetic Effects of Electric Current
chapters.sourceReview: Twenty original English–Tamil questions in two sets cover magnetic field lines, right-hand thumb rule, straight wire, circular loop, solenoid, electromagnets, magnetic force, Fleming's left-hand rule and domestic wiring safety. Topic scope cross-checked against SATHEE/IIT Kanpur textbook text and NCERT-aligned chapter maps; Independent 2026–27 page accuracy checking and Tamil translation editorial sign-off remain pending.

chapters.title: Our Environment
chapters.sourceReview: Twenty original English–Tamil questions in two sets cover ecosystem components, trophic levels, 10-percent energy transfer, food webs, decomposers, biomagnification, stratospheric ozone and CFCs, biodegradable versus persistent waste, composting and segregation. Chapter topics checked against SATHEE/IIT Kanpur and NCERT-aligned current edition guides; independent official 2026–27 page verification and Tamil editorial certification remain pending.
